plan.title: Qualify material identity
plan.question: Which exact strain, reference and material does the hypothesis concern?
plan.comparison: Intended study material against its own qualified reference; CC-503 reference annotation does not establish UVM4 equivalence.
plan.independent_units: Define biological material lots and their relationship; technical sequence checks are not independent organisms.
plan.completion_check: All identity links resolve, or unresolved links remain explicitly blocked.

plan.title: Qualify the fluorescence readout
plan.question: What does the reporter signal measure in this proposed system?
plan.comparison: Researcher-qualified reporter condition against matched background and reference; no algae/GFP construct is linked here.
readouts: Raw signal and background with units
Separate genotype and protein identity evidence
plan.independent_units: Specify independently prepared biological units; repeated instrument reads are technical observations.
required_before_run: Approved fluorescence SOP and instrument-setting IDs
plan.completion_check: A traceable assay report separates signal, background, normalization and limitations; fluorescence alone cannot confirm an edit or phosphorus recovery.

plan.title: Measure growth alongside the target
plan.question: Can the intended endpoint be interpreted alongside growth in the same qualified context?
plan.comparison: Candidate and matched study reference; published lines retain their own source controls.
controls: Matched measurement basis and observation window
readouts: Growth endpoint, unit and time basis
plan.independent_units: Set a justified biological replication plan; published n=3 is not a sample-size prescription for this study.
plan.completion_check: Source/context and uncertainty are documented; unknown margin cannot be reported as an equivalence pass.

plan.title: Separate phosphorus compartments
plan.question: Where did the phosphorus move, and which chemical form was measured?
plan.comparison: Input inventory and disjoint measured output/storage compartments in a qualified material comparison.
plan.independent_units: Independent material/process units; aliquots from one unit are not independent replication.
required_before_run: Approved phosphorus assay SOPs and uncertainty plan
plan.completion_check: Report concentration change, inventory change, recovered product and unaccounted mass separately; no assimilation or transformation claim from disappearance alone.

plan.title: Assess a contained reactor comparison
plan.question: Does a qualified material comparison support a reproducible endpoint change in the intended reactor context?
plan.comparison: Researcher-defined candidate versus matched reference and process controls; no edited microbe or reactor batch is linked yet.
readouts: Input/output phosphorus mass and time basis
Material identity and end-of-run verification records
plan.independent_units: Independent reactor runs/units; timepoints within one run do not substitute for independent runs.
required_before_run: Context, randomization/blocking, replication and analysis decisions
plan.completion_check: A complete run receipt binds material identity, controls, measurements and uncertainty. No deployment, inoculation recipe or improvement claim is supplied.

plan.title: Keep plant use as a separate question
plan.question: Is recovered phosphorus useful under a separately defined plant-use endpoint?
plan.comparison: Researcher-qualified recovered material against appropriate reference and background conditions.
controls: Assay/background reference chosen for the plant-use endpoint
plan.independent_units: Define independent units for this separate question; upstream reactor runs are not plant-use replicates.
required_before_run: Plant-use question, assay SOP and acceptance criteria
Appropriate study authorization and independent-unit plan
plan.completion_check: Plant-use evidence is reported separately; reactor removal or product phosphorus cannot stand in for this result.
